comments.note: ThumbnailsOptions.ThumbnailSize has no range guard — a value of 0 or negative would be accepted and could cause downstream issues if thumbnail generation consumes it. No validation is required by the current AC but worth flagging for future implementation.

The interaction between KeepOriginalSize=true and a non-default ThumbnailSize is undefined at the options layer. Documentation in ThumbnailsOptions.cs describes them independently, but consumer code will need to decide precedence. No current consumer exists yet so no bug, just a future design note.

3 pre-existing integration test failures in DapperMovieRepositoryTests (GetOriginalFilenameAsync_*) due to schema migration m041 not applied to test DB. These are unrelated to WP-001 and were failing before this WP.
